description: Search the General Chiropractic Council (GCC) public register of UK chiropractors, or look up exact registration numbers.

city.description: Filter practices by city or town, e.g. `London`, `Manchester`, `Edinburgh`. GCC resolves this to a geographic area on their end, so nearby towns (e.g. `Didsbury`, `Sale` for `Manchester`) may also appear — matching the site's own "Find a Chiropractor" tool.
city.title: City / town (mode=search)

country.description: Filter practices by country, e.g. `United Kingdom`, `Ireland`, `Australia`, `Singapore` (GCC-registered chiropractors sometimes practise abroad).
country.title: Country (mode=search)

gender.description: Only return chiropractors of this gender.
gender.title: Gender

name.description: Full or partial name to search for (matches first name, last name, or both, e.g. `Smith` or `Julia Smith`). Leave blank to browse the whole register.
name.title: Name (mode=search)

postcode.description: A UK postcode (e.g. `SW1A 1AA`). Results are geocoded and returned nearest-first, matching the site's own "Find a Chiropractor" tool.
postcode.title: Near postcode (mode=search)

qualificationContains.description: Only return chiropractors whose listed qualification contains this text, e.g. `AECC`, `Doctor of Chiropractic`.
qualificationContains.title: Qualification contains

region.description: Filter practices by county or region, e.g. `Surrey`, `West Yorkshire`.
region.title: County / region (mode=search)

registeredAfter.description: Only return chiropractors first registered on or after this date.
registeredAfter.title: Registered after (YYYY-MM-DD)

registeredBefore.description: Only return chiropractors first registered on or before this date.
registeredBefore.title: Registered before (YYYY-MM-DD)

registrationNumbers.description: Exact GCC registration numbers to look up, e.g. `01913` or `1913`.
registrationNumbers.title: Registration numbers (mode=byRegistrationNumber)

registrationStatus.description: Only return chiropractors whose registration status contains this value.
registrationStatus.title: Registration status

title: UK Chiropractor Register Scraper Input
